scope: Read-only mathematical/source audit; no probe/map fitting, neural forward, checkpoint loading or actual new results inspected.

checks.detail: For C=Yc.T@Xc=U S Vh, R=U@Vh minimizes ||YcR-Xc||_F over O(d). The built-in synthetic test expects q.T when target=x@q.

checks.name: length_weighting
checks.detail: Each length contributes cross-product divided by its own fit count. Summing rather than averaging over21 is a positive constant factor and leaves the polar factor unchanged. One global256x256map per unit/encoding/phase/pairing, not21maps.

checks.name: fit_split_and_probe
checks.detail: read_length retains original orbit-disjoint fit/dev/test selections. Map cross-products use probe-fit validation rows only; source ridge/scaler tune on source-dev labels only. No held-out test rows enter maps, means or tuning.

checks.name: common_complement_scoring
checks.detail: direct/means_only/three pairedmaps/eightshuffles all score target valleys test action1 with original peak positions using same source probe. All rotations use same complement validation mean and source mean. Native-action rows are auxiliary.

checks.name: phase_and_encoding_scope
checks.detail: Both initial/trained phases and bothencodings; initialphase refitsseparateprobes. Descents/recoils suppliedcontrols are trained one-line only; no automaticcycleextension.

checks.name: raw_versus_standardized
checks.detail: Schema-adapted NPZ stores raw FP32 final_norm; alignment uses raw centered coordinates. Source StandardScaler is internal to each per-length probe. R is orthogonal in raw hidden coordinates, not necessarily in standardized probe coordinates.

checks.name: shuffle_definition
checks.detail: Eight fixed seeds1026..1033 generate count-stratified cyclic derangements within length. Every nonsingleton stratum movesallrows; singletonstrata remain. Seeds and permutations are paired across encodings/phases withinunit. Shuffles are controls, not independent replicationunits.

checks.name: labels_and_priors
checks.detail: Paired maps do not use positiontargets. Shuffle grouping uses true source peakcounts. position_prior conditions on true testcount, so it is an oracle-count baseline. Target-own valleys probe is a separately fitted positive reference, not a negative control.

checks.detail: Supplied code checks targetCPdigest andfullarangeindex but not all data/cache bindings; adapter/wrapper must check NPZsource SHA, datasplit length/order, actual checkpointreceipts andinitialidentity. Include dataSHA in added provenance ifdesired.

checks.name: finite_support
checks.detail: Main code rejects any summary with fewer than21finite lengths. average() excludes examples withundefinedwithin-exampleAUC; retain n andfinitecounts separately. Matchedsupport shouldhaveidenticalfinitecounts acrossallprimarymaps.

Eachcontrast computed afterfixed1/21aggregate, notmean oflength-specificmaxima. No seeds/lengths/shuffles asindependenttaskpairs.
